game_concept: A puzzle set in The Kingdom – Tavern Quarter, the lively tavern district: the town guard must handle siege rats while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Swap Switch: Swap two variables with a temporary slot to reroute apples without losing either value.
theme: The Kingdom – Tavern Quarter: the lively tavern district
core_gameplay_loop: In Tavern Quarter, repeat each round: Swap two variables with a temporary slot to reroute apples without losing either value. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the a value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the market bell using at most 20 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The market bell reached with actions_used <= 20.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 20 before the market bell is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 5 (applied tier): Swap Switch
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Swap Switch' (Week 1 slot 4), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Tavern Quarter'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
